title: HLA-B*44:02 with the self peptide EEFGRAFSF. The clearest anchor demonstration in this set: Glu at P2 is buried in the B pocket, Phe at P9 in the F pocket - the two pockets the Boltz-2 embeddings were pooled over.
citation: Macdonald WA et al. (2003) J Exp Med 198:679. PMID 12939341

title: HLA-B*27:05 with the self peptide LRNQSVFNF. Textbook B-pocket case: Arg at P2 in the deep acidic B*27:05 B pocket (Glu45, Cys67, His9), Phe at P9 in the F pocket.
citation: Lim Kam Sian TCC et al. (2019) J Biol Chem 294:20185. PMID 31740583

title: HLA-A*02:01 with the HTLV-1 Tax 11-19 epitope LLFGYPVYV. The primary paper is specifically about peptide-HLA complex stability, which makes it the natural anchor for this sprint.
citation: Khan AR, Baker BM, Ghosh P, Biddison WE, Wiley DC (2000) J Immunol 164:6398. PMID 10843695

title: HLA-A*11:01 with the SARS-CoV nucleocapsid peptide KTFPPTEPK. Canonical A*11:01 anchors - Thr at P2 in the B pocket, Lys at P9 in the F pocket - and the highest resolution binary complex in this set.
citation: Blicher T, Kastrup JS, Buus S, Gajhede M (2005) Acta Crystallogr D 61:1031. PMID 16041067

title: HLA-A*01:01 with the MAGE-A1 tumour antigen EADPTGHSY. Classic A*01:01 anchoring - Asp at P3 and Tyr at P9 - showing that not every allele anchors primarily at P2.
citation: Kumar P, Vahedi-Faridi A, Saenger W, Ziegler A, Uchanska-Ziegler B (2009) Protein Sci 18:37. PMID 19177349

title: The structure named in the challenge PDF - but it is NOT a binary peptide-HLA complex. It is a TCR / peptide-HLA ternary complex carrying an 8-mer HIV-1 reverse transcriptase epitope, at the lowest resolution in this set, and HLA-B*51:01 does not appear in the Rasmussen dataset. Included for completeness and to show TCR engagement, not as a representative stability structure.
citation: Motozono C et al. (2014) J Immunol 192:3428. PMID 24600035
caveat: 8-mer, not 9-mer; TCR ternary complex (chains D/E are TCR alpha/beta, with a second copy F-J in the asymmetric unit); allele absent from the dataset.
